name: vllm_cutlass_scaled_mm
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench vLLM test_cutlass_scaled_mm.py. INT8 scaled GEMM: a (M,K) int8 row-major, b (K,N) int8 column-major (stride(0)==1, built via .t()), scale_a/scale_b fp32, out_dtype in {fp16,bf16}, optional bias (N,) in out_dtype. Reference calls vLLM _custom_ops.cutlass_scaled_mm and returns the (M,N) result. Only b needs column-major layout so it is built in gen_inputs; a/scale_a/scale_b/bias are plain randn/randint (random). out_dtype passed as a string scalar and resolved via getattr(torch,...). Source parametrizes scale_case in {all_scalar,row_a_col_b} and bias_mode in {None,vector}; migrated workloads fix scale_case=row_a_col_b and bias_mode=vector. No torch-native fallback; requires vLLM at eval time.
